subject: Follow-up: Delta Summit intro & next steps on inference evaluation
messages:
From: Mateo Alvarez <mateo@redwood.ai>
To: Samantha Li <samantha.li@quantixa.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben@redwood.ai>
Date: Sun, 14 Feb 2027 10:15:00 -0800
Subject: Follow-up: Delta Summit intro & next steps on inference evaluation

Hi Samantha — great meeting you at Delta Summit today. Evan, good to meet you as well.

Quick recap from our 20-minute chat: we discussed Quantixa's plan to add live inference for product recommendation and the two things you called out as priorities: low 95th-percentile latency under 120ms and predictable per-request cost at scale. You mentioned the main blockers are integration effort and proving that a cheaper open-model + quantization approach can meet your quality bar.

Proposal / next steps I suggested:
- Pilot (2–4 week): Redwood hosted endpoint with a small dedicated pool, run your top-10 prompts + CTR reranker.
- Success criteria: P95 < 120ms at 99% availability; embedding similarity delta < 2% vs current baseline on the provided eval set.
- Data/inputs we need from you: 500 representative requests (anonymized), current latency histogram, and a short eval list (~200 examples) for quality checks.

I attached a short Delta Summit intro deck with the pilot outline and a one-sheet mutual action plan (QNTX-MAP-v1.xlsx). If it helps, I can loop in Ben (cc'd) to propose a tailored perf/cost estimate and share a quick notebook to reproduce the eval locally.

Are you available Wed/Thu next week for a 30-minute kickoff? I linked my calendar below.

Thanks,
Mateo Alvarez
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
mateo@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0198

Attachments: Delta_Summit_Intro_Deck.pdf (6 pages), QNTX-MAP-v1.xlsx (mutual action plan)

From: Mateo Alvarez <mateo@redwood.ai>
To: Samantha Li <samantha.li@quantixa.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 16 Feb 2027 09:48:00 -0800
Subject: RE: Follow-up: Delta Summit intro & next steps on inference evaluation

Samantha — quick follow-up in case this slipped through. Happy to be flexible on scope: we can start with a very small smoke test (100 daily queries) if that speeds approval.

If you prefer, Evan and I can run an internal readout first and then loop in your infra/security folks. Either way, a short kickoff to agree inputs would unblock us.

Proposed times (Pacific): Wed 2/17 10:00–10:30, Thu 2/18 11:00–11:30. Calendly: https://calendly.com/mateo-redwood/30min

Thanks — Mateo

From: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.ai>
To: Mateo Alvarez <mateo@redwood.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 19 Feb 2027 13:02:00 -0800
Subject: Internal: Quantixa follow-up + low-cost pilot idea

Mateo — quick note after reviewing the MAP and target numbers. A couple of thoughts before the next external ping:

- We should offer a 2-week "proof-of-economics" credit: 50% off hosted tokens + no infra commit if they keep below 10k tokens/day. That lowers their procurement hurdle.
- Prepare two perf profiles: (1) open Llama-3 13B quantized + prefix caching, (2) Redwood-verified 70B trimmed model for quality checks. That gives them a low-cost path and a fallback.
- I'll draft a sample eval notebook that ingests their 200 examples and outputs P95/Throughput/quality delta charts.

I'll attach the sample pricing blurb and a short checklist for infra/security asks before we send another bump. Want me to send that to Samantha directly or do you want to lead?

— Ben

From: Samantha Li <samantha.li@quantixa.ai>
To: Mateo Alvarez <mateo@redwood.ai>
Cc: Evan Chu <evan.chu@quantixa.ai>
Date: Mon, 22 Feb 2027 16:05:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Follow-up: Delta Summit intro & next steps on inference evaluation

Hi Mateo — apologies for the slow reply, we were finalizing Q1 roadmap. Thanks for the clear recap and the MAP. Evan and I took an initial look and we like the pilot outline. Two quick items: 1) we need the pilot to run in us-west-2 for compliance, and 2) can you confirm that data will not persist beyond the pilot (short-term KV/cache only)?

We can do Thu 2/25 at 11:00 PT for a kickoff — that works for Evan and me. Please send a calendar invite and Ben, feel free to join to walk through the perf options.

Samantha
Head of ML Platform | Quantixa AI
samantha.li@quantixa.ai
